summary: Kanawha County lookout near Putney, WV, registered 2008; a cabin was at the tower by 1927; removed, with no removal date or site description found.

facts.status_note: Register says the tower has been removed; no removal date or description of the site today was found
facts.agency: State of West Virginia (register: administered by)

events.note: December 1927 newspaper notice of a hiking club visit; a cabin had been built at the tower
March 1970 newspaper reports a tower observer died of a heart attack while working at the tower
Registered September 16, 2008, nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.supports: tower in the vicinity of Putney
administered by the State of West Virginia
December 1927 hiking club visit planned, two days and nights at the tower
evidence.quote: During the Christmas holidays members of the hiking club will visit the forest fire tower on Mt. Desert in the vicinity of Putney, where they will spend two days and nights.

evidence.supports: cabin had been built at the tower
evidence.quote: A cabin has been constructed at this tower which makes it ideal for week-end camps.

evidence.supports: observer died of a heart attack while working at the tower
evidence.quote: died early Wednesday of a heart attack while working at the Mount Desert Fire Tower at Putney

evidence.supports: observer worked for the Department of Natural Resources
evidence.quote: He was a tower observer for the Department of Natural Resources.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts names the West Virginia Division of Forestry
Firelookout.org list marks the tower Tower Gone
evidence.quote: Desert, Mount Kanawha 38.28949 -81.37581 Tower Gone FFLOS US 163, WV 13

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register lists the State of West Virginia as administering the tower; Forest Lookouts names the West Virginia Division of Forestry; a 1970 article names the Department of Natural Resources for the observer. The sources use different agency names and the story reports the register's wording.

sources.title: Mount Desert Tower Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites (Forest Fire Lookout Association)

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build year, no removal date, no description of the site today, and no access information. Register gives 1,650 ft (503 m); a mapcarta peak elevation of 1,611 ft is for the summit and was not used. Brief's agency matches the register.
